name: mcp-feedback
description: Agent feedback for MCP servers: one skill for adding the mcp-feedback library to a server and updating the server's own skills to use it, and one for reading and closing out what was collected, over the mcp-feedback CLI or MCP reader tools.

interface.shortDescription: Collect and act on agent feedback for MCP servers
interface.longDescription: Adds a feedback loop to MCP servers. Agents using a server file structured feedback about failures, friction and missing capabilities; each report is tied to the authenticated caller and stored in SQLite, Postgres or a store you write. One skill covers integrating the library into a server and updating the server's own skills so agents file good feedback; the other covers reading, clustering and closing out what was collected.
defaultPrompt: Add agent feedback to this MCP server
Summarize the feedback agents filed this week
Close out the feedback we fixed in the last release
